input.title: DOES CRIME IMPACT BANK CARD ACCEPTANCE?
input.abstract: This paper investigates whether crime impacts the probability of bank card acceptance. We build an indicator composed of theft variables concerning primarily both consumers and merchants. We use a document published by the Home Office, the etat 4001, to associate to each merchant the crime level of his department. We find that a high level of financial crime discourages card acceptance, while a high level of violent crime fosters it. The first effect interpreted to be the result of adverse selection, while the second effect results from a partial internalization of risks borne by consumers.

output.reasoning: O artigo não atende aos critérios básicos de busca por palavras-chave do protocolo (métodos computacionais, lavagem de dinheiro ou crime organizado) nos campos de título, resumo ou palavras-chave dos autores.
